name: Kagi o Kakushita Kago no Tori -Bird in Cage Hiding the Key-
original_name: 鍵を隠したカゴのトリ-BIRD IN CAGE HIDING THE KEY-
source:
Touko was taken into custody on suspicion of committing murder and testified that she was the culprit. However, she was subsequently released due to insufficient evidence. The general public did not approve of this, so she ended up being imprisoned in a large mansion.

Youta was once saved by Touko when he was young, and he decided to live with her in the mansion after his grandmother was hospitalized, leaving him all alone. They were joined by Touko’s friend Mion, the class rep Yoru, and their eccentric classmate Izuru. He felt that it was a pleasant life, cooking together, chatting about random things and having the occasional argument.

But who is the true culprit? And why did Touko confess to the crime? Can the caged girl be saved?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/10/01/october-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
灯子因涉嫌谋杀而被拘留，并证实自己是凶手。但由于证据不足，她随后被释放。公众并不认可她的做法，所以她最终被囚禁在一座大宅里。

佑太小时候曾被灯子救过，祖母住院后，他决定和灯子一起住在宅邸，留下他一个人。灯子的朋友美音、班代表夜和古怪的同学伊鹤也加入了他们。他觉得这样的生活很愉快，一起做饭，聊一些闲事，偶尔也会争吵。

但真正的罪魁祸首是谁呢？而灯子为何要承认自己的罪行呢？被关在笼子里的女孩还能被拯救吗？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/10/01/october-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~Omochikaeri！[/url]]
